answer_en: Ajay Kumar Garg Engineering College (AKGEC) was established in 1998 by the Indian School of Computer Science.
answer_hi: Ajay Kumar Garg Engineering College ki sthapna 1998 mein Indian School of Computer Science dwara hui thi.

question_variants: what programs are available at AKGEC
kaun kaun se courses hain college mein
B.Tech M.Tech MCA available hai kya
answer_en: AKGEC offers 4-year undergraduate B.Tech courses in all major disciplines, 2-year post-graduate M.Tech in four disciplines, and a 2-year MCA program.
answer_hi: AKGEC mein major branches mein 4-year B.Tech, 4 branches mein 2-year M.Tech, aur 2-year MCA program available hai.

question_variants: What is the sanctioned intake for B.Tech MCA and M.Tech
college mein total kitni seats hain
answer_en: The sanctioned intake is 1,320 seats for B.Tech across all disciplines, 120 seats for MCA, and 72 seats for M.Tech across four branches.
answer_hi: College mein B.Tech ki 1320 seats, MCA ki 120 seats, aur M.Tech ki 72 seats sanctioned hain.

answer_en: AKGEC is spread across a 40-acre campus situated at 27th Km Stone, Delhi-Meerut Expressway (NH-24), Ghaziabad, Uttar Pradesh 201015.
answer_hi: AKGEC 40 acre campus par sthit hai jo 27th Km Stone, Delhi-Meerut Expressway (NH-24), Ghaziabad, UP 201015 par hai.

question_variants: What are the college office timings
college office kab khulta aur band hota hai
answer_en: The administrative office is open Monday to Friday from 9:00 AM to 5:00 PM, and on Saturday from 9:00 AM to 1:00 PM. It is closed on Sundays and gazetted holidays.
answer_hi: Administrative office Monday se Friday subah 9:00 se shaam 5:00 tak aur Saturday ko 9:00 se 1:00 baje tak khula rehta hai.

question_variants: Who is the Director and Director General of AKGEC
college ke director ka naam kya hai
answer_en: Dr. Hemant Ahuja serves as the Director of AKGEC, and Dr. R.K. Agarwal serves as the Director General.
answer_hi: Dr. Hemant Ahuja AKGEC ke Director hain, aur Dr. R.K. Agarwal Director General hain.

question_variants: is AKGEC NBA and NAAC accredited
answer_en: AKGEC is affiliated to Dr. A.P.J. Abdul Kalam Technical University (AKTU, Lucknow) with College Code 027, approved by AICTE, and its major B.Tech disciplines are NBA accredited.
answer_hi: AKGEC Dr. A.P.J. Abdul Kalam Technical University (AKTU) se code 027 ke saath affiliated hai, AICTE dwara approved hai, aur B.Tech branches NBA accredited hain.

question_variants: How many books are in the central library
answer_en: The central library is fully automated and houses over 1,00,000 books, national and international journals, and multimedia resources with smart RFID-card entrance access.
answer_hi: Central library poori tarah automated hai aur usmein 1,00,000 se zyada books, national/international journals, aur smart RFID access uplabdh hai.

question_variants: Does the library have digital resources and online journal access
DELNET and NDL access in library
answer_en: The library subscribes to DELNET, National Digital Library (NDL), NPTEL, Coursera, edX, and IEEE databases, accessible to all enrolled students and faculty.
answer_hi: Library mein DELNET, National Digital Library (NDL), NPTEL, Coursera, edX, aur IEEE e-resources enrolled students aur faculty ke liye available hain.

question_variants: Is there a previous year question paper bank in the library
previous year question papers library mein milte hain kya
answer_en: Yes, the Central Library maintains a dedicated Question Papers and Model Solutions Bank containing previous sessional, Pre-University Test (PUT), and university examination papers with model solutions.
answer_hi: Haan, Central Library mein previous sessional, Pre-University Test (PUT), aur university exams ke question papers aur model solutions ka bank available hai.

question_variants: Are there departmental and hostel libraries
answer_en: The AKGEC Library System includes the Central Library, nine departmental libraries, and five hostel libraries with books on loan from the Central Library.
answer_hi: AKGEC Library System mein Central Library ke alawa nau departmental libraries aur paanch hostel libraries hain.

question_variants: Is campus Wi-Fi enabled and what are computing facilities
how many computers are on campus
answer_en: The campus is Wi-Fi enabled with high-speed broadband networking over 1,400 computers across all academic departments, computing centers, and hostels.
answer_hi: Campus high-speed Wi-Fi se equipped hai aur 1400 se zyada computers broadband se networked hain.

question_variants: What Centres of Excellence and industrial training centres are at AKGEC
answer_en: AKGEC houses 15+ industry-collaborated Centres of Excellence, including AKGEC-KUKA Industrial Robotics Training Centre, NI LabVIEW Academy, Siemens PLM, Bosch Rexroth Centre of Competence, and Janatics Industrial Pneumatics.
answer_hi: AKGEC mein 15 se zyada industry Centres of Excellence hain, jaise KUKA Robotics, NI LabVIEW Academy, Siemens PLM, aur Bosch Rexroth Automation.

answer_en: AKGEC FabLab is an MIT-affiliated digital fabrication facility equipped with 3D printers, laser cutters, CNC machines, and rapid prototyping tools for student innovators.
answer_hi: AKGEC FabLab MIT affiliated digital fabrication facility hai jo 3D printers, laser cutters, aur rapid prototyping tools provide karti hai.

question_variants: What student technical societies operate at AKGEC
answer_en: Active technical societies at AKGEC include Conatus, Computer Society of India (CSI), IEEE Student Branch, SAE Collegiate Club, and Cloud Computing Cell.
answer_hi: AKGEC mein active technical societies Conatus, CSI student chapter, IEEE, SAE, aur Cloud Computing Cell hain.

question_variants: What cultural and literary societies are on campus
answer_en: Cultural and extracurricular societies include Oorja (dance, drama, music), Phoenix (arts and culture), Horizon (literary society), and Rotaract Club for social community service.
answer_hi: Cultural activities ke liye Oorja (dance, drama, music), Phoenix (arts), Horizon (literature), aur Rotaract club active hain.

question_variants: What sports and fitness facilities are available
gym and sports ground at AKGEC
answer_en: The campus features a cricket pitch, football ground, outdoor basketball and tennis courts, badminton courts, indoor table tennis, equipped gymnasiums, and organizes the annual sports fest Spardha.
answer_hi: Campus mein cricket ground, football field, basketball court, badminton, table tennis, gymnasiums, aur annual sports fest Spardha aayojit hota hai.

question_variants: What is the placement record of AKGEC
answer_en: AKGEC maintains high placement records with 2000+ placement offers and 213+ recruiters annually, including TCS, Infosys, Wipro, Cognizant, Amazon, and Capgemini.
answer_hi: AKGEC mein 2000+ offers aur 213+ recruiters aate hain jinmein TCS, Infosys, Wipro, Amazon, aur Capgemini shamil hain.

question_variants: What is the mandatory attendance requirement
attendance kitni chahiye exam ke liye
answer_en: A minimum of 75% attendance across all lectures and practicals is strictly mandatory under AKTU and college regulations to appear in end-semester examinations.
answer_hi: End-semester exams mein baithne ke liye AKTU aur college norms ke mutabiq minimum 75% attendance anivarya hai.

question_variants: What is the anti-ragging policy and student safety measures
answer_en: AKGEC maintains a strict zero-tolerance anti-ragging policy with 24x7 security, comprehensive CCTV surveillance, and an active Anti-Ragging Committee and Squad.
answer_hi: AKGEC mein anti-ragging zero-tolerance policy hai jismein 24x7 security, CCTV surveillance, aur Anti-Ragging Committee sakriya rehti hai.

question_variants: How can I take admission in B.Tech at AKGEC
JEE Main rank se admission kaise hota hai
answer_en: B.Tech admissions are conducted primarily through Uttar Pradesh Technical Admission Counselling (UPTAC) based on JEE Main merit ranks, alongside institutional management seats per state guidelines.
answer_hi: B.Tech admission mukhya roop se JEE Main rank ke aadhar par UPTAC counselling ke through aur institutional management seats par hota hai.

question_variants: What is the eligibility criteria for B.Tech admission
answer_en: Candidates must have passed 10+2 with Physics and Mathematics as compulsory subjects and Chemistry/Biotechnology/Computer Science, securing minimum 45% marks (40% for SC/ST).
answer_hi: B.Tech ke liye candidate ko 10+2 mein Physics aur Mathematics ke saath minimum 45% marks (SC/ST ke liye 40%) prapt karna anivarya hai.

question_variants: Is there lateral entry admission to B.Tech 2nd year
answer_en: Yes, candidates holding a 3-year Engineering Diploma or B.Sc degree with Mathematics are eligible for lateral entry admission directly into the 2nd year (3rd semester) through UPTAC counselling.
answer_hi: Haan, 3-year Engineering Diploma ya Mathematics ke saath B.Sc pass candidates UPTAC lateral entry counselling ke through 2nd year mein direct admission le sakte hain.

question_variants: How can I take admission in MCA at AKGEC
answer_en: MCA admissions are based on Common University Entrance Test PG (CUET-PG) scores. Eligibility requires BCA or graduation with Mathematics at 10+2 or degree level with minimum 50% marks (45% for SC/ST).
answer_hi: MCA admission CUET-PG rank se hota hai. Candidate ke paas BCA ya graduation mein 50% marks (SC/ST 45%) aur Mathematics hona anivarya hai.

question_variants: How can I take admission in M.Tech at AKGEC
answer_en: M.Tech admissions require a B.Tech degree in the relevant discipline with minimum 50% marks (45% for SC/ST), evaluated through valid GATE scores or CUET-PG.
answer_hi: M.Tech ke liye relevant discipline mein B.Tech (minimum 50% marks, SC/ST 45%) aur valid GATE ya CUET-PG score aavashyak hai.

question_variants: What meritorious scholarships are available for B.Tech and MCA
answer_en: Students with JEE Main AIR up to 25,000 for B.Tech, or CUET-PG AIR 1-750 for MCA, receive college merit scholarships, renewable upon maintaining 90% attendance and CGPA 7.5+ with no backlogs.
answer_hi: JEE Main AIR 25,000 tak ke B.Tech students aur CUET-PG AIR 1-750 ke MCA students ko merit scholarship milti hai, jise 90% attendance aur 7.5+ CGPA se renew kiya jata hai.

question_variants: Is there tuition fee scholarship for M.Tech students
answer_en: M.Tech students securing 65% aggregate in B.Tech receive approx Rs 25,000 waiver, 70%+ receive 50% tuition waiver (approx Rs 50,000), and 75%+ receive 75% waiver, with special 5% relaxation for AKGEC alumni.
answer_hi: M.Tech mein B.Tech 65% marks par Rs 25,000, 70% par 50% tuition fee waiver, aur 75% par 75% waiver milta hai (AKGEC alumni ko 5% aggregate chhoot).

question_variants: How can I apply for UP Government Post-Matric Scholarship
scholarship form for SC ST OBC students
answer_en: Eligible SC, ST, OBC, General, and EWS students can apply for the UP Government Post-Matric Scholarship through the official scholarship.up.gov.in portal and submit verified hard copies to the College Registrar office.
answer_hi: Eligible students UP Government scholarship.up.gov.in portal par apply karke verified hard copies College Registrar office mein jama kar sakte hain.

question_variants: How can students pay the college fee
can I pay fees by NEFT RTGS or Demand Draft
answer_en: Fees can be paid online via the college ERP fee portal (net banking, debit/credit cards), through NEFT/RTGS bank transfer, or by Demand Draft in favour of 'Ajay Kumar Garg Engineering College' payable at Ghaziabad or Delhi.
answer_hi: Fees online ERP portal se, NEFT/RTGS bank transfer se, ya 'Ajay Kumar Garg Engineering College' ke naam bane Demand Draft se jama ki ja sakti hai.

question_variants: What details should be written on the demand draft
DD ke peeche kya likhna hota hai
answer_en: Write the student's full name, roll number or application number, branch, and contact mobile number on the back of the draft. It can be submitted in person at the accounts counter or sent via registered post.
answer_hi: Demand Draft ke peeche student ka naam, roll number, branch, aur mobile number likhein; ise accounts counter par ya registered post se submit karein.

question_variants: Is the counselling amount adjusted in college fees
counselling deposit fees mein adjust hoga kya
answer_en: Yes, the full seat acceptance fee deposited during UPTAC counselling is credited and deducted from the candidate's total first-year college fee.
answer_hi: Haan, UPTAC counselling ke samay jama ki gayi seat acceptance fee total first-year college fee mein se deduct kar di jaati hai.

question_variants: What is the late fee fine for overdue semester fees
late fee fine kitni lagti hai
answer_en: A late fine of Rs 100 per day applies on semester fee dues after the notified deadline, up to a maximum period of 15 days.
answer_hi: Notified due date nikalne ke baad 100 rupaye roz ka late fine lagta hai, adhikatam 15 dino tak.

question_variants: Is the caution money refundable and how much is it
caution money kab wapas milti hai
answer_en: The caution money of Rs 5,000 paid during admission is a refundable security deposit, returned to the student upon graduation and completion of the no-dues clearance.
answer_hi: Admission ke dauran li gayi 5000 rupaye ki caution money program complete hone aur no-dues clearance ke baad poori refundable hoti hai.

question_variants: What benefits are covered under medical charges in the fee
medical insurance cover in college fee
medical charge mein kya facilities milti hain
answer_en: Annual medical charges cover hospitalisation insurance up to Rs 50,000, personal accident insurance up to Rs 1,00,000, and free annual OPD consultations at Dr. R.S.G. (Indo-German) Hospital.
answer_hi: Medical charges mein 50,000 rupaye tak ka hospitalization insurance, 1,00,000 tak ka accidental cover, aur Dr. R.S.G. Hospital mein free annual OPD checkup shamil hai.

question_variants: Do students pay university exam fee to AKGEC or AKTU
exam fee kisko pay karni hoti hai
answer_en: The university examination fee and digital consortium fee are collected directly by AKTU via the AKTU ERP student portal as per university notification.
answer_hi: University examination fee aur digital consortium fee seedhe AKTU dwara unke official portal par li jaati hai.

question_variants: Where can I get the fee receipt after payment
payment receipt for income tax or loan
answer_en: Fee receipts are generated digitally on the college ERP portal under Fee Payment within one working day of online transfer or DD clearance, suitable for tax and education loans.
answer_hi: Fee receipts payment clearance ke baad ek working day mein college ERP portal par Fee Payment section mein download ke liye uplabdh hoti hain.

question_variants: Can the college fee structure change during the course
fee structure badal sakta hai kya
is the college fee fixed for 4 years
answer_en: The fee structure is subject to revision as determined periodically by the Uttar Pradesh State Government Fee Fixation Committee for private engineering institutions.
answer_hi: College fee structure UP State Government Fee Fixation Committee ke nirdeshon ke anusaar badla ja sakta hai.

question_variants: When are AKTU semester end examinations conducted
odd and even semester exam dates
answer_en: Odd semester theory examinations are typically conducted in December-January, and even semester examinations in May-June, as notified on the official AKTU academic calendar.
answer_hi: Odd semester ke exams December-January mein aur even semester ke exams May-June mein AKTU calendar ke mutabiq aayojit hote hain.

question_variants: What are internal sessional tests and PUT examinations
Pre-University Test PUT kya hota hai
answer_en: The college conducts two internal sessional exams and one comprehensive Pre-University Test (PUT) per semester to evaluate continuous internal assessment marks.
answer_hi: College mein continuous assessment ke liye har semester do internal sessional tests aur ek Pre-University Test (PUT) conduct hota hai.

question_variants: Where and when can students download their exam admit card
hall ticket download for semester exams
answer_en: Admit cards are published on the AKTU ERP student portal approximately three days prior to the commencement of the first theory examination.
answer_hi: Admit card pehle exam se lagbhag teen din pehle AKTU ERP portal par download ke liye uplabdh ho jaata hai.

question_variants: Where is the examination seating plan displayed
answer_en: The daily exam seating plan is displayed on physical notice boards of respective academic blocks and published on the college ERP portal one day before each exam.
answer_hi: Exam room aur seating plan har academic block ke notice board aur ERP portal par exam se ek din pehle lagaya jata hai.

question_variants: How can a student apply for answer sheet re-evaluation or scrutiny
answer_en: Students can apply for challenge evaluation or scrutiny online through the AKTU ERP portal within 7 to 15 days of result declaration upon paying the university fee.
answer_hi: Result aane ke 7 se 15 din ke andar AKTU ERP portal par prescribed fee jama karke challenge evaluation ya scrutiny ke liye apply kar sakte hain.

question_variants: What are the rules for back paper and carry-over examinations
back paper kab de sakte hain
answer_en: Carry-over examinations (back papers) for odd semesters are held alongside regular odd semester exams, and even semester carry-overs alongside regular even semester exams.
answer_hi: Odd semester ki back paper odd semester exams ke saath aur even semester ki carry-over even semester exams ke saath de sakte hain.

question_variants: How do graduating students collect provisional degree and final transcript
answer_en: Provisional degree certificates and consolidated grade cards are issued by the College Registrar office after final semester result clearance and submission of the no-dues slip.
answer_hi: Provisional degree aur marksheet final result clearance aur no-dues slip jama karne ke baad College Registrar office se milti hai.

question_variants: How many hostels are on campus and what is the total capacity
answer_en: The college provides six hostels spread across four complexes: Junior Boys, Senior Boys, Junior Girls, and Girls Complex, accommodating over 1,500 students.
answer_hi: College mein 6 hostels hain jo 4 complexes mein split hain: Junior Boys, Senior Boys, Junior Girls, aur Girls complex, jinmein 1500+ students reh sakte hain.

question_variants: Where do first year boys stay
first year hostel separate hai kya
answer_en: First-year boys stay in the dedicated Junior Boys Hostel complex in double occupancy rooms, ensuring a secure and ragging-free environment.
answer_hi: First-year boys Junior Boys Hostel complex mein double-seater rooms mein rehte hain jo bilkul ragging-free aur secure hai.

question_variants: What are the accommodation facilities for girls
answer_en: Female students are accommodated across three secure girls' hostels featuring double and triple seater rooms with an intake of approximately 600 students.
answer_hi: Chhatraon ke liye teen surakshit girls hostels hain jinmein double aur triple-seater rooms hain aur 600 students reh sakte hain.

question_variants: What time do hostel gates close
hostel kitne baje band hota hai
answer_en: Hostel gates close strictly at 10:00 PM on weekdays (Monday to Friday) and at 11:00 PM on weekends (Saturday and Sunday).
answer_hi: Hostel gate weekdays mein raat 10:00 baje aur weekends par raat 11:00 baje band ho jaate hain.

question_variants: What are mess timings for breakfast lunch and dinner
khana kab milta hai hostel mein
answer_en: Mess timings are: Breakfast from 7:30 AM to 9:00 AM, Lunch from 12:30 PM to 2:00 PM, and Dinner from 7:30 PM to 9:00 PM.
answer_hi: Mess ka time hai: Breakfast subah 7:30 se 9:00, Lunch dopahar 12:30 se 2:00, aur Dinner raat 7:30 se 9:00 baje tak.

question_variants: Is hot water and Wi-Fi available in hostels
garam paani milta hai kya hostel mein
answer_en: All 6 hostels are equipped with solar water heaters for hot water supply, high-speed Wi-Fi connectivity, TV lounges, canteen stores, and gymnasiums.
answer_hi: Sabhi 6 hostels mein garam paani ke liye solar water heaters, high-speed Wi-Fi, TV lounge, canteen, aur gym uplabdh hain.

question_variants: How can a student request a hostel room change
answer_en: Room change requests must be submitted using Form H-4 to the Chief Warden office within 7 days of room allotment, subject to mutual agreement and room availability.
answer_hi: Room change ke liye allotment ke 7 din ke andar Chief Warden office mein Form H-4 bharkar jama karein.

question_variants: What is the procedure for night leave or outpass from hostel
hostel se bahar jane ki permission
answer_en: Hostelers must apply for night leave through the online warden portal with verified parental consent via registered phone/email at least 24 hours prior to departure.
answer_hi: Hostel se bahar raat rukne ke liye parent verification ke saath 24 ghante pehle online portal par warden permission lena anivarya hai.

question_variants: Does the college provide bus service and which routes are covered
answer_en: AKGEC runs a fleet of college buses covering extensive routes across Delhi, Noida, Greater Noida, Ghaziabad, Meerut, Anand Vihar, and Dilshad Garden for day scholars.
answer_hi: AKGEC Delhi, Noida, Greater Noida, Ghaziabad, Meerut, aur Anand Vihar ke sabhi mukhya routes par college bus service chalata hai.

question_variants: How can students apply for a bus pass and pay transport fees
answer_en: Students apply for bus passes through the Transport Coordinator desk by submitting the route registration form and paying transport fees for the semester or academic year.
answer_hi: Bus pass lene ke liye Transport Coordinator desk par route registration form submit karke semester ya annual transport fee bharein.

question_variants: What are college bus arrival and departure timings
bus subah kab aati hai aur shaam ko kab nikalti hai
answer_en: College buses reach the campus by 8:30 AM in the morning and depart from the campus bus bay at 5:10 PM on all working days.
answer_hi: College buses subah 8:30 baje tak campus pahunchti hain aur working days par shaam ko 5:10 baje campus se nikalti hain.

question_variants: What medical emergency and ambulance facilities are on campus
answer_en: AKGEC maintains an on-campus medical dispensary with visiting medical officers, nursing staff, and a dedicated 24x7 ambulance tied to Dr. R.S.G. (Indo-German) Hospital.
answer_hi: AKGEC campus mein visiting doctor aur nursing staff ke saath dispensary hai aur Dr. R.S.G. Hospital se connected 24x7 ambulance seva uplabdh hai.

question_variants: What is the emergency helpline and security protocol
answer_en: For immediate campus emergencies, contact the 24x7 Campus Security Control Room at the Main Gate or dial police helpline 112 for external emergency response.
answer_hi: Kisi bhi emergency mein Main Gate sthit 24x7 Security Control Room se sampark karein ya external emergency ke liye 112 dial karein.
